title.zh: 新加坡国立大学（公司化）（解散日期）公告 2008
title.en: National University of Singapore (Corporatisation) (Dissolution Date) Notification 2008

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the National University of Singapore (Corporatisation) (Dissolution Date) Notification 2008 and shall be deemed to have come into operation on 28th December 2006.
2. The date specified for the purposes of section 18(3) of the Act is 28th December 2007.
